description: AGENT side, REAL execution. Request a URL; if it answers 402 with a Gloam private price, pay it privately from this server's notes (same limits as gloam_execute_private_pay), retry, and return the response. Understands both dialects: an MPP challenge (WWW-Authenticate: Payment with method gloam, answered with Authorization: Payment) is preferred when offered, else x402 (X-PAYMENT). Also pays x402 scheme gloam-cashout (a gateway on Robinhood Chain that pays out to a public address): a cash out of exactly the quoted USDG from this server's notes to that address, sent through the Gloam relay. The payee and the amount are public there; this server's wallet and balance are not. gloam-cashout needs maxAmount. With gloam-private and gloam-cashout both offered, gloam-private is paid unless prefer says gloam-cashout. The agent never handles a note secret or the payment header unless a retry is needed. A call whose answer never arrived is not paid twice: the same call again gets that answer, presents the first payment, or answers payment_in_progress while it is running. Requires GLOAM_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY to pay.

maxAmount.description: Refuse if the 402 asks for more than this, in the asset's units. Needs the asset's decimals from Gloam's list or the limits file; for any other asset the fetch is refused.

note.description: Handle of the note to pay from; omit to use the smallest that covers the price.

paymentHeader.description: Present a payment already made (paymentHeader from an earlier result: an X-PAYMENT value or an MPP Payment credential) instead of paying again.

prefer.description: Which x402 scheme to pay when the resource offers both gloam-private and gloam-cashout. Default gloam-private, which keeps the payee private too.

name: gloam_fetch_paid
title: Fetch a paid resource (x402 or MPP, paid privately)
